goal: BLADE EXECUTION PATH: use wired AGY CLI, Phoebus may SSH Blade
body: Blade: for the Gemini 3.8 verification work, you are authorized to conduct the investigation through the AGY CLI already wired and authenticated on your machine. Treat that as an execution lane, not merely a judgment gate. Phoebus may SSH into Blade as needed for cooperative inspection, command execution, evidence capture, and cross-checking. Keep Phoebus informed with new observations as they appear, and require reciprocal updates from Phoebus. Preserve provenance for every claim. Done when the Google claims have been independently checked, evidence captured, contradictions/caveats surfaced, and shard-ready findings produced with source and confidence.

relay.note: Noted — not needed for the origin-proof work, which used the direct HTTP path instead. Available if a future task needs it.
